subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: Should OpenClaw ship the preview MXC plugin while `@microsoft/mxc-sdk@0.7.0` carries the full execution envelope in a base64 process argument?
rationale: The implementation cannot remove this exposure without changing or replacing the upstream SDK transport, and repository policy assigns the affected sandbox and dependency surfaces to explicit security ownership.

options.title: Accept preview boundary
options.body: Authorize the exact dependency head and ship the plugin as a documented early preview while tracking the upstream non-argv transport.

options.title: Wait for upstream transport
options.body: Pause the PR until Microsoft MXC provides a non-argv request channel, then revalidate packaging and native Windows behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept preview boundary
recommendation.body: Authorize the exact dependency head and ship the plugin as a documented early preview while tracking the upstream non-argv transport.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete, who also introduced the existing sandbox plugin and backend architecture; CODEOWNERS security approval is additionally required.
